scope: 23 unqualified legacy AS-001 dates; classification only. No runtime consumer, date rewrite, new overlay or assessment.

definitions.verified_date: Contemporaneous provenance establishes the assessment date, beyond a repeated storage literal.
definitions.converter_fallback: The inspected source input and converter rule demonstrate replacement of a missing or non-date source value by 2024-01-15.
definitions.unknown: Actual assessment date is not established. storageOrigin separately records whether a literal predates this converter.

authority.note: 23 July ratification calls the notional cohort the common converter fallback and explicitly says storage dates remain provenance-suspect. This classifies the date limitation, not evidence depth; this review distinguishes the observed immediate ingestion path from the authority’s broader legacy-fallback terminology.

converter.rule: Missing ISSUED, notional, march, mid-, or non-year-leading text is replaced with 2024-01-15; a literal year-leading 2024-01-15 is preserved.
converter.openedDateRule: extractMetaVal(RECORD OPENED) || 2024-01-15 is separate from assessment date conversion; do not transfer an assessment-date classification to openedDate or question raisedDate.
